name: aiseo-quarterly-competitor-watch
prompt: Run competitor-analysis with user_url = primary site from MEMORY.md and competitor_urls = first 3 entries from MEMORY.md '## 主要竞品'. Use focus=all. Produce the 3-section comparison report with delta matrix. If MEMORY.md has < 2 competitors set, ask the user and skip this run.

_aiseo_notes.purpose: quarterly cadence — user site vs tracked competitors; long enough that meaningful structural changes can be picked up
_aiseo_notes.tool_budget: <= 7 web_extract calls (1 user + up to 5 competitors + 1 retry); 0 browser
_aiseo_notes.deliver_choice_rationale: same as weekly-audit — local sink, no messaging
